decisions.reason: The battery-connector access constraint does not change the board's installation orientation, USB-C edge placement, mounting holes, compactness, or aspect ratio.
Physical access to the battery cable does not change the NTC terminal, connector assignment, thermal-protection function, or controller.
The connector-clearance concern does not alter electrical battery protection, its controller, or cutoff voltages.
Battery-cable accessibility does not affect the charge-status display method, GPIO, or dedicated-LED decision.
The source concerns physical access to a battery connector, not I2C cable length, speed, pull-up resistance, or pull-up location.
The source does not change native USB data lines or USB-connector sourceability.
The battery-connector layout constraint does not change the selected addressable LED family or its data GPIO.
Physical battery-cable access does not alter the 5V boost converter, enable control, powered loads, default state, or usage pattern.
